checks: Four viewports × real mouse/touch: pull both bars outward to fold, inward to restore; one state change per drag, same native question and chosen answer
Wrong direction, horizontal movement, Escape cancellation and touch cancellation never toggle a bar or trigger a click underneath
Click/tap, Enter/Space-compatible buttons and directional arrow keys remain available with named 44px targets
One actual fullscreen action hides both bars without persisting temporary choices; pulling restores controls; button/browser exit restores each previous bar state and the answer
Rejected fullscreen leaves both bars usable and preserves the original preference/state
No duplicate hide-bars/new-tab control; explicit drag choices survive reload and both handles restore the desktop
scope: Real mouse and Chromium touch input, native fullscreen events and local fixture accounts; no production writes.
